description: Hand-labelled topic pairs for the positions index (roadmap #43, analysis/positions.py). 'same' pairs are topic strings from data/analysis/predictions.json that a reader would file under one subject; 'different' pairs are ones that must stay apart, chosen to be hard (a shared word, or subjects he discusses in the same breath). The clustering threshold is measured against this set: `make positions ARGS=--sweep` scores each candidate threshold, and tests/test_positions.py fails if the shipped positions.json breaks a pair or a pair's topic no longer exists. Text-free (topic labels only), so it is committed like eval/embedding_queries.json. The first 12 same / 10 different pairs chose the 0.60 threshold on 2026-10-01; the rest were added afterwards, unseen, as a held-out check.
